title: Chicken and vegetable soup with barley
steps: Chop the carrots, celery and leek and sweat them in the oil for 4 minutes.
Add the stock and rinsed barley, put in the whole chicken breasts and simmer gently for 20 minutes.
Remove the chicken, dice it and return it, then simmer for 10 more minutes until the barley is soft.
Season with salt and pepper and serve with parsley.
